changes: VECTOR is back to sample tracks only, as in 0.2.5. The MIDI-track generator from 0.3.0 moves to its own module, VECTOR MIDI.
Card builds: VECTOR's second page (SEED, SPAN, OFST, ROT, RPT, DIR) can now open beside POLY8 (#1119).
Over USB this installs the 0.2.5 package, which ran on a unit.
Known issue: the card build is not yet tested on hardware.
New: VECTOR generates phrases on MIDI tracks. Double-tap SRC (or the track key in MIDI mode) and choose VECTOR; its controls are on SRC, AMP and FUNC+AMP.
On a MIDI track OCT, VEL and GATE are the track's NOTE, VEL and LEN; PROB puts trig conditions on off-beat notes, HUMN adds micro-timing. The Octatrack's own sequencer plays it.
Turning a control is faster on audio and MIDI tracks; the generated phrases are the same as before.
Card builds: VECTOR's second page also opens beside POLY8 (#1119).
Known issue: not yet tested on hardware with this exact build; a power cycle and project save and reload are untested.
Over USB, a double tap on SRC on a VECTOR track now opens VECTOR's second page (SEED, SPAN, OFST, ROT, RPT, DIR) instead of the stock Flex or Static setup (#972).
Needs the current Modwerk beta base; on an older base SRC SETUP stays as before.
Card builds are unchanged.
Known issue: saving and reloading, a power cycle with VECTOR kept and listening are not yet tested on hardware.
Fixes saved VECTOR settings making the Octatrack reject the bank at startup, which reset machines to STATIC and left PLAY stuck on the first step. Existing settings are kept.
Projects already reset by this bug need to be restored from a backup.
Installs over USB beside every other module on the Modwerk beta base.
Documentation only: switching a VECTOR track back to STATIC or FLEX with SPAN 8 or higher can empty the bank after a save and reboot; the guide shows how to avoid it (#596).
Known issue: #596 is not fixed, and a reboot and the audio are not yet tested on hardware.
First Modwerk release of VECTOR, an SRC pattern generator for Flex and Static sample phrases.
Adds sample selection and two control pages; generated phrases edit the current pattern.
Known issue: saved projects and hardware are not yet tested.
